statement:
{X} [NormedField X] [LinearOrder X] [IsStrictOrderedRing X] [FloorSemiring X] (a : ℕ → X) (ha : SeqBdd a) :
  ∃ σ, Subseq σ ∧ IsCauchy (a ∘ σ)
name: BolzanoWeierstrass
content: If a sequence `a : ℕ → X` (where `X` could be `ℚ` or `ℝ`) is bounded, then it has a subsequence which is Cauchy.
